## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Footer

**Figma frame:** _Footer_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-18 (buttons and states), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Bottom section containing project links, resources, GitHub reference, and secondary navigation.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Footer information architecture for project links, resources, GitHub, and secondary navigation.
- Link grouping, responsive stacking, and legal or supporting content placement if present.
- Hover and keyboard-focus states for all interactive links.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile footer frames with link states.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Project links, resources, GitHub reference, and secondary navigation are represented
- [ ] Link groups remain readable and navigable at mobile widths
- [ ] Interactive states meet dark-mode contrast requirements
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
